comparison.objective: Insert a keyed memory module into slot A2 and close both latches.
comparison.physical_skill: Key alignment, narrow-slot insertion, downward seating force, and latch closure.
comparison.success_condition: Module seated in A2 with both latches shut; no numeric seating tolerances are stated.
comparison.reason: This is keyed insertion and latching, not impact-controlled fracture at a manufactured notch or recovery of released fragments.
